gpt-6.1-sol.evidence: Official release and API guidance; independent AA max/xhigh task scores.
gpt-6.1-sol.retention: Suggested main model for complex coding and knowledge work; at max its AA Briefcase, HLE and Omniscience scores exceed Terra max.
gpt-6.1-sol.limits: No task-set validation in Magpie. Exact immutable checkpoint not disclosed.

gpt-6-astra.evidence: Official release with math, coding, browsing, screen grounding and professional-work results; AA max/xhigh.
gpt-6-astra.retention: Suggested for demanding math/research and difficult integrated engineering; strongest AA HLE and science scores among the three priority candidates at max.
gpt-6-astra.limits: No direct architecture-planning benchmark. max is not best on every metric.

gpt-6.1-terra.evidence: Official visual/computer-use and factuality results; independent AA max comparison to Sol max.
gpt-6.1-terra.retention: Suggested for image/screen workflows and bounded tool-based coding or science tasks; AA max equals Sol max on displayed TB4 and TBScience, with lower aggregate API cost.
gpt-6.1-terra.limits: AA knowledge reliability and agentic knowledge-work scores trail Sol. Vendor visual parity lacks exact chart values in the text.

gpt-6-sol.evidence: Official task results with explicit effort; current guide and pricing.
gpt-6-sol.retention: Documented none-effort support unlike Sol 6.1; this is an interface/behavior option. Public evidence gives stronger general task results for Sol 6.1.
gpt-6-sol.limits: No independent current scores for this model collected by this subtask. Visual encoding updated 2026-09-25.

gpt-6-luna.evidence: Official max DeepSWE and high AutomationBench relative improvement; official targeted high-volume role; current lowest API prices among these eight.
gpt-6-luna.retention: Suggested for focused, high-volume work when its observed quality suffices; has native none effort.
gpt-6-luna.limits: API price does not identify subscription charge. No independent current scores collected here. Visual encoding updated 2026-09-25.

gpt-5.6-sol.evidence: Official full benchmark table including coding, math, PDFs, visual reasoning, browsing and professional work; later Astra comparisons.
gpt-5.6-sol.retention: No contemporary overall advantage established against Sol 6.1 or Astra. Historical DeepSWE 72.7 exceeds the separately published GPT-6 Sol 68.8, but conditions/effort are not matched.
gpt-5.6-sol.limits: Old tables use benchmark revisions and partially unspecified efforts. Agents Last Exam text/table disagree. Chat model variant is different from API/Codex/Work variant.

gpt-5.6-terra.evidence: Official full table and direct Terra 6.1 comparisons.
gpt-5.6-terra.retention: No current task or cost advantage established against Terra 6.1 in the reviewed sources.
gpt-5.6-terra.limits: Absence of an advantage in this bounded review is not evidence of domination on every user task.

gpt-5.6-luna.evidence: Official full table and GPT-6 Luna high-effort workflow improvement.
gpt-5.6-luna.retention: No current general advantage established against GPT-6 Luna. Historical DeepSWE 67.2 versus GPT-6 Luna 66.6 is a separately reported result with unmatched effort.
gpt-5.6-luna.limits: No independent same-harness latest comparison collected here.
